caveats: ⚑ skill2 block 1 (105.58%) has NO activation clause in the prose — trigger AND cadence are INVENTED (interval 10s placeholder). Its whole damage contribution is unmeasured; treat the slot-2 total as unpinned until the internal CD is datamined or popup-counted.

⚑ Both Electric-Code-gated blocks (skill2 Damage Taken ▲5.64%×5, burst +164.83%) are INERT on the neutral scope-lock boss and on any non-Electric graded comp — they move zero damage in the current board and are therefore unvalidated by any regression run.

⚑ burst block 2 is keyed to burstCast + bossElementGate, NOT to a per-shot trigger, despite the literal 'when attacking' wording — a per-normal-attack 164.83% rider would be ~12× the unit's own normal-attack multiplier (13.65%), which fails the whole-picture check. If footage on an Electric target shows repeating 164.83% popups outside the burst cast, re-key to shotFired.
⚑ noFb:true on both burst hits follows the burst-cast FB-exemption convention (a burst cast lands before the FB window opens), not a measurement.

Sibling-name note (NOT a leak): the redacted schema comments reference base `helm` (charge-damage multiplier / treasure burst / heal-to-Crown / critRateNormalPct). `helm` and `helm-aquamarine` are DIFFERENT units; none of this unit's magnitudes or slug appear in the methodology, and none of base helm's mechanics were carried into this override.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only (no board, no driver override, no probe data). Structure: S1 = a 30-normal-hit-count rider (131.34% flat, crits, no core — the text does not say 'core strike') + an FB-enter team burst-CDR escalator (Liter-style cumulative: 1st FB 1.82s, 2nd 1.82+2.2s, 3rd+ 1.82+2.2+2.6s per the 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' clause). S2 = a trigger-less 105.58% single-random-enemy hit modeled as an interval (⚑ cadence invented) + an Electric-Code-gated stacking boss debuff (Damage Taken ▲5.64%, 5 stacks, 5s — a team-wide boss debuff, not a self buff). Burst = 164.83% to all enemies on cast, plus an equal 164.83% additional hit gated on an Electric-Code boss. No weapon-state, heal/shield, HP/DEF, Hit-Rate, stack-currency, pierce or weapon-swap lines exist in this kit, so none were skipped; `unmodeled` is empty for all three slots because every kit line is represented by a block. `noRange` left unset (engine-automatic); `noFb` left unset on the S1/S2 riders so they take Full Burst by timing (default ON).

flags.estimate: interval{sec:10} (first fire t=10s; ~6 procs in a 60s fight)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the 105.58% line has NO activation clause, so both the trigger KIND and its cadence are outside the input domain. Hard rules say a clause-less damage line = interval; 10s is a mid-range placeholder for an AR attacker S2 internal CD, chosen without evidence. If the true CD is 5s this block is under-credited 2×; if 20s, over-credited 2×.
flags.recipe: Read skillCooldownsSec for helm-aquamarine skill2 in the datamine (per the skill-CD first-fire convention: no 'Activates when' clause ⇒ interval trigger, first fire at t=CD). Cross-check by counting 105.58%-tier popups per minute in a solo recording.

flags.estimate: burstCast + bossElementGate 'Electric' (fires once per own burst), NOT shotFired
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ trigger identity. The clause reads 'when attacking an Electric Code target', which literally suggests per-attack; but 164.83% of final ATK per normal shot is ~12× this unit's own normal-attack multiplier (13.65%) — a whole-picture contradiction. Its identical magnitude to the burst's main hit is the tell: it is the burst's conditional half. The sibling skill2 Electric clause (5.64% stacking debuff, 5 stacks) IS plausibly per-shot and is modeled that way, so the two clauses are deliberately read differently.
flags.recipe: Record a fight vs an ELECTRIC-code boss and count 164.83%-tier popups: exactly 2 per burst cast ⇒ current model; a steady per-shot stream ⇒ re-key to shotFired. No Electric boss available ⇒ this stays a HYPOTHESIS (both blocks are inert on the graded board, so no regression can discriminate them).

flags.estimate: true (both burst hits excluded from the +50% Full-Burst major)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6 (per-kit noFb is measured-only, default OFF) held against the kit-parse hard rule that burst-cast/instant damage is always FB-exempt because the cast resolves before the FB window opens. I applied the hard rule, but it is a CONVENTION here, not a measurement for this unit; if the engine instead expresses this via burstSnapshotsPreFb, this flag double-counts the exemption (no damage error, but a redundant encoding).
flags.recipe: Read one burst popup off a recording and divide by (final ATK × 1.6483 × crit/core state): a 1.5× residual ⇒ drop noFb. Also confirm with the engine owner whether burst flatDamage on a burstCast trigger already force-sets FB-exempt (then remove the field).

flags.estimate: datamined values as given; AR ~12 pulls/s ⇒ hitCount:30 fires roughly every ~2.5s of sustained fire (~1 proc per magazine-third)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and a NOMINAL rate must be snapped to 60fps frame boundaries (effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal)). The S1 rider's whole cadence — and therefore its share of total damage — hangs on this, since it is a hit-count trigger, not a timer.
flags.recipe: Read the ammo counter frame-by-frame in a solo recording (shots/sec measured directly) rather than inferring from FB counts; compare against the datamined nominal and the 60fps-snapped effective rate.

flags.estimate: rider crits at the caster's sheet rate, never core-boosted
flags.reasoning: Prior #9: function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate but get NO core unless the text says 'core strike damage' — this text says only 'additional damage'. Range is engine-automatic (not set). Not derivable from prose alone; it is a prior, not a measurement.
flags.recipe: Read 131.34%-tier popups in a solo recording: orange/crit-iconed bodies present ⇒ crit:true confirmed; any red 'CORE HIT' at that tier ⇒ add core.

flags.estimate: cumulative — FB#1 = 1.82s, FB#2 = 4.02s, FB#3+ = 6.62s total CDR to all allies
flags.reasoning: 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' maps 1:1 onto the escalating primitive (Nth activation applies steps 1..N). The open question is the post-3rd behaviour: does it hold at the full 6.62s stack every subsequent FB (assumed) or stop? The prose does not say. This is a rotation-shaping effect, so an error here moves FB counts, not just a damage number.
flags.recipe: Judge by MEASURED FB count, not board ratio: run a comp with this unit and compare simulated FB timestamps against a recording anchored to the exact 03:00→02:59 frame. An extra/missing FB late in the fight indicates the post-3rd-entry behaviour is wrong.

flags.estimate: shotFired (every trigger pull applies a stack while the boss is Electric)
flags.reasoning: 'When attacking' is ambiguous between pull-fired and hit-landed. With 5 stacks × 5s and an AR cadence, either reading saturates the debuff at 5 stacks almost immediately, so the choice is very likely damage-neutral in practice — but it is still an unmeasured reading, and it would matter for a missed-shot model.
flags.recipe: Inert on the current board (non-Electric boss). If an Electric-boss recording exists, check the debuff-icon stack count ramp on the boss HP bar over the first ~1s of fire.
